q: What is the carbon footprint of packaged coconut water?
title: Packaged coconut water footprint
short: Packaging and transport often matter most. Count the nuts as bought, then cutting and filling, pasteurisation or cold processing energy, the carton, PET or can, chilling and delivery. Husk and shell waste can be a fuel or a cost; record where it goes.
audience: Coconut water processors and beverage brands

ul: Tender coconuts bought and their transport.
Processing electricity and any boiler fuel.

p: If sold as fuel or coir, they leave your boundary. If dumped, include waste handling.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol standards, including the Product Standard
